story.2: e.g. The Silent Strength of a Disciplined Man
story.3:
Blank lines separate paragraphs (= 1 scene each).
## Chapter heading  … starts a chapter (becomes a chapter in the description)
[[query:storm clouds]]  … sets the footage for that paragraph (optional)

## The Lonely Road

Every man reaches a point where nobody claps for him anymore.

And that is exactly where his real life begins.
posts.3: Search titles, file names and tags
upload.19: Drop in recordings and the tool removes the music, transcribes them and flags ads and announcements. Review what gets cut, then turn them into videos. The look (captions, colour, BGM) is set at the bottom of this page.
upload.20: Drag & drop audio (several files or whole folders)
upload.28: Look for videos made from audio
upload.40: Remove the music and keep only the voice
upload.41: Demucs (AI source separation) removes the BGM and levels the voice before the video is made. Captions are transcribed from the voice alone, so they are more accurate.
upload.43: Finds app promos, sponsors, subscribe requests and opening/closing greetings with the local AI (Ollama) and keywords, and cuts them. You can review and fix the cuts on the Upload page.
upload.45: Free tracks by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), automatically lowered while someone speaks. They are CC BY 4.0, so the credit for the track is added to the description automatically.
upload.55: Captions whose size, colour and motion change word by word. Strong words get bigger, numbers get colour.
upload.81: Accurate downloads about 460 MB the first time
upload.83: Don't download (use only footage on this Mac)
upload.84: Normally unused footage is used and then moved to the "used" folder; anything missing is downloaded from Pexels when needed. When this is on, used footage is reused if there isn't enough unused footage.
upload.86: Make the publishing kit automatically (title, description, tags, thumbnail, posting folder)
upload.87: Every time a video is finished, the local AI (Ollama) writes the publishing text and thumbnail, and the tool's output/posting folder is updated.
upload.89: Checks video vs. audio length (within 0.5 s), decodes the whole file, the audio track, resolution, captions and leftover ads. The result shows on the Publish page as "QA OK / Needs a look".
upload.90: Also check that captions match the voice (60 s, Whisper)
create.5: Pick a recording and generate. Adjust the look with the settings on the right (saved automatically).
create.9: Drag & drop audio, or click to upload
create.11: Re-make if a video with the same name exists
story.10: Paste a script and this Mac's voice model (Dia) narrates it, then pictures, captions (kinetic-captions) and BGM are added to make the video. The local AI can draft the script for you. To make a video from a recording, use Upload.
story.14: Let the AI draft it (local AI, free)
story.25: Ollama (qwen2.5) writes an English script chapter by chapter. 35 minutes takes a few minutes. The draft lands in the box below: read and edit it before making the video.
story.28: Saved automatically. Each paragraph becomes one scene (voice, picture, captions).
story.31: See which footage each paragraph will get before rendering. If one is wrong, add
story.33: to the paragraph to pin that footage (
story.36: Re-make if a video with the same title exists
story.44: See it on the Publish page
story.62: Subfolders are searched too. The AI picks what fits each paragraph; folder and file names (e.g. rain, boxing) help as well.
story.64: Added to every picture so it looks like the same person. Names of real people and existing characters are removed automatically.
story.79: Add a font from Google Fonts
story.80: — find a font you like and paste its name or URL (or the embed code). Free (mostly OFL) and fine for videos.
story.90: Detailed settings for Simple captions come from "Look for videos made from audio" at the bottom of the Upload page.
auto.3: Turns every mp3 in a folder into a video. New mp3s added while it runs are picked up within a minute.
library.3: Videos use unused footage, which is then moved to the used folder. When there isn't enough, new footage is downloaded from Pexels, so no clip is used twice.
library.8: Used to download new footage. Without a key, videos are made from the footage on this Mac only. Get a free key at
library.12: Tracks by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com): CC BY 4.0, free and fine to monetise. The only condition is a credit in the description, which is added automatically. Turn off any track you don't want.
library.16: Optional: footage is downloaded automatically when a video needs it. The keywords are used for that too.
library.19: Move used footage back to unused
rights.3: Checks where each video's speech comes from and how likely it is to get a copyright claim. Shazam looks for released recordings, and you can log YouTube's check result.
rights.11: Checking sends three 12-second audio snippets per video to Shazam. "Released recording" is a hint that a claim is likely, not a legal judgement. The most reliable check is YouTube Studio's "Checks" after a private upload.
posts.5: Copy the title, description and tags for YouTube. Mark videos as posted once they're up.
js.app.reset_confirm: Reset all settings to their defaults?
js.app.auto_stop_confirm: Stop auto generate? Videos in progress will be discarded.
js.app.no_tracks: No tracks yet. Press "Find more tracks".
js.app.no_fresh: No unused footage. It is downloaded automatically for the next video.
js.app.recycle_confirm: Move all used footage back to unused? (The same clips will be used again.)
js.inbox.empty: No audio yet. Drag and drop files onto the box above.
js.inbox.nothing_to_gen: Nothing to generate (check that analysis has finished)
js.inbox.delete_confirm:
Delete {n} audio files?
(Finished videos are kept.)
js.posts.no_posts: No videos in output/videos to post
js.rights.label: label
js.rights.use_detected_tip: Use the artist Shazam found as the source
js.rights.source_saved: Source saved (also updated in the post text)
js.fonts.need_query: Enter a font name or URL
js.story.bhatt_hint: Low, calm voice · black-and-white ink illustrations with slow zoom · grain · kinetic captions · deep BGM. For 30–50 minute narrated videos.
js.story.dia_missing: Dia isn't installed, so edge-tts will be used
js.story.dia_hint: Makes a natural, human-like voice on this Mac (free). It takes time (about 3–4 minutes per minute of narration). Lines with off pitch are redone automatically.
js.story.ai_ready: Ready: FLUX.2 klein draws the pictures on this Mac (drawn images are reused).
js.story.ai_downloading: The image model is downloading. Until then, black-and-white stock footage is used.
js.story.ai_missing: The image model isn't ready, so black-and-white stock footage is used.
js.story.kc_hint: Strong words appear larger, numbers in colour. Spelling follows the script.
js.story.need_text: Enter a title and script to start
js.story.estimate: Final length: about {len}{imgs}. Long videos take a while (it keeps going if you close this page).
js.story.lost: The server restarted, so progress can't be tracked. Check the Videos page.
js.story.failed: Couldn't make it (see the log below)
js.story.replace_saved: Replace the current script with the saved one?
js.story.replace_ai: Replace the current script with an AI draft?
js.story.draft_done_hint: Draft ready. Read and edit it, then press "Make video"
js.story.draft_failed: Couldn't write a draft (see the log below)
js.story.analyzing: Analyzing footage… (the first run takes longer with many files)
js.story.matched: Matched {paras} paragraphs from {n} clips. Yellow frames are weak matches (the folder may have few fitting clips).
settings.lede: Settings for the whole app. Per-video looks are chosen under "Finish" on the Create page.
settings.lang_hint: Language of menus, buttons and messages
settings.start_hint: The page shown when the app opens
settings.system_hint: Voice (Dia) and images (FLUX) never run at the same time. Work pauses below 25% free memory and resumes at 35% (so swap doesn't wear the SSD).
settings.part_ollama: AI for script drafts and search terms (started only when needed)
story.batch_hint: Pick saved scripts and they are made into videos one at a time, in order, with the "Finish" settings on the right (never at the same time, so the Mac isn't overloaded). Progress shows under "2. Make the video".
story.batch_drop: Drag & drop script files (.txt) to add them (the first line is the title)
story.batch_start: Make the selected scripts in order
js.story.batch_confirm:
Make {n} scripts into videos in order with the current "Finish" settings?
(Videos with the same title are redone if "Redo" is on.)
js.story.batch_cancel_confirm: Stop the rest after the current video finishes?
voice.title: Use your own voice (from a recording)
voice.hint: Add a clear 5–15 second English recording and Dia reads the script in a voice like it (processed only on this Mac). Recordings without noise or music match best.
voice.name: Name
voice.text: What is said in the recording (left empty: transcribed automatically)
voice.consent: This is my voice, or I have permission to use it
js.voice.del_confirm: Delete this voice? (The recording is removed too.)
js.voice.need_consent: Only your own voice or one you may use can be added (tick the box)
js.voice.adding: Adding the voice… (transcribing takes a moment)
js.voice.added: Voice added. Pick it under Narrator
